text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—I see. I'm glad you're doing well. ...Why 
do I sound surprised? Well, it's not every 
day you call me out of the blue, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Eh? ...You watched my mock race? You 
didn't have to. The result was just—..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm totally fine. Of course I am, 
who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now now... don't you worry. Just wait 
patiently, okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It might not be right away, but... —I 
promise I'll show ya someday.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A glorious flower in full bloom... one 
magnificent enough to surpass her.
